report.summary: Frozen-manifest audit of 2b338e3→ee2072c (17 changed paths) confirms the three interactive-audit medium corrections are implemented as documented. (1) New crypto publications now declare the nearest-prior 'asof' benchmark alignment while stocks stay 'exact_sessions'; existing stored records are byte-for-byte untouched and legacy crypto imports are covered by committed tests. (2) Advisory conditions carry an explicit thesis_role (supports_thesis/reconsideration_trigger/unspecified); measurement IDs exclude the role, conflicting roles coalesce to unspecified with a warning, display labels separate predicate truth from thesis meaning, the PM schema/prompt request intent, the advisory_thesis contract is versioned 1→2, and a compiled-graph test exercises memory→observation→PM prompt→publication→restart for all three roles. (3) Disclosure validation now rejects quotes truncated immediately before a percent-plus qualifier (including without context packages) and rejects 'historical' claims whose explicit dates/years exceed min(as_of, filed_date), failing closed on parse errors and not inventing fiscal calendars. The closure record and evidence JSON are internally consistent (live attempt 7/7, $2.8199875 run / $18.410925 cumulative within the $70 subceiling, five endpoints pending, final target unsupported) and candidly scope out unverified items (no exact-commit CI, no live classified-condition met/breached observation, deferred low findings). No critical or high defects found; residual issues are low-severity presentation/semantic edges and a provenance gap between the live-proof commit (2945b2a) and the audited head (ee2072c).
limitations: Audit was restricted to the frozen request.json (requirements text + unified diff); no tests were executed and no working-tree, git, or network verification was performed, so recorded results (2230-test full suite, live-run artifacts, hashes, costs) are taken from the frozen record rather than reproduced.

The final live proof's source_head is intermediate commit 2945b2a, not the audited head ee2072c; the frozen manifest cannot confirm the intervening delta is docs-only, so live/runtime coverage of the exact head is not independently established (the closure doc itself marks the connected targeted audit as pending).

Whether schemas.py's PM-facing ThesisCondition is the same class as memory/thesis.py's (and therefore structurally accepts thesis_role from model output) cannot be confirmed from the diff hunks alone; only the description string change in schemas.py is visible.

The rejection path for a truncated value_quote (committed test test_full_lower_bound_quote_cannot_use_truncated_exact_numeric_projection) is asserted by test but the specific rejecting check lies outside the diff context, so I could not trace it; the cuts_percent_plus guard itself inspects claim.quote only.

Settlement-side 'asof' measurement behavior (benchmark nearest-prior close logic) is pre-existing code not shown in the diff; its correctness is inferred from the committed weekend-window test and recorded suite pass, not inspected directly.

Claims about PM instruction length (70178 chars condensed under a 70000 bound), artifact SHA-256 values, and live-run report contents could not be checked against actual files under the no-non-frozen-evidence constraint.

findings.title: Outcome summary renderer defaults missing benchmark_alignment to 'asof', so any pre-field stored record would be displayed with the asof policy note and benchmark-date suffix it never declared

prepare_thesis role inheritance prevents explicit demotion: a re-proposed condition with thesis_role 'unspecified' silently inherits the prior classified role, so intent cannot be reset to unknown without retiring the condition

Final live proof executed on intermediate commit 2945b2a rather than audited head ee2072c; docs-only equivalence of the delta is not verifiable from the frozen manifest, leaving exact-head runtime coverage formally unproven (partially disclosed as pending)

cuts_percent_plus truncation guard checks claim.quote only, not the effective numeric value_quote; rejection of truncated value_quote relies on other validation paths outside the diff, traceable only via the committed test
Percent-plus guard rejects on any occurrence of the quote followed by '+' anywhere in the block text (fail-closed but may reject a legitimately exact duplicate occurrence of the same phrase)
